newsitem.title: USA: Latin American Casinos eyes Colombia, Nicaragua.
newsitem.headline: Latin American Casinos eyes Colombia, Nicaragua.

text.p: Latin American Casinos Inc said Tuesday it has received governmental approval from Colombia and Nicaragua to begin gaming route operations on a participation basis in those countries.
The company said it expects to place thousands of slot machines in drug stores, bars, pool halls, restaurants and nightclubs by mid-March.
The venture is expected to increase profitability and cash flow and limit accounts receivables, said the company, which has 7,000 slot machines in inventory.
Despite recent setbacks in the Peruvian market, the company says it remains the largest slot machine rental and manufacturing company in South America.
